item.title: Domestic Flytipping & Commercial Bins Woolwich Road SE10, 22nd August
item.description:
It is entirely possible that the domestic dumping I had previously reported back in June was attended to this morning. These photo's were taken last night and it is daily occurence. If I was the pharmacy I would be getting rather upset as it looks appalling. This needs addressing as I'm getting tired of reporting it. Also the business next door keeps its commercial bins out the front on the pavement seven days a week twenty four hours a day. They are an eyesore and leech liquids onto the pathway and obviously block the path too. Lastly they block the zebra crossing at the cycle path making it a hazard for pedestrians and cyclists. Please get these two issues sorted as they are a blight on this busy junction and reflect poorly on East Greenwich and RBoG.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Woolwich Road, Greenwich
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Setchell estate resident large scale flytipping, 22nd August
item.description:

Bed bases, internal doors, mattress, tent, cases, cupboards, wood, metals and more. This needs clearing as the same family are adding to it every other day with no thought of the unsightly and unacceptable consequences to nearby residential properties. Signs and cameras are needed here to deter flytippers.
